calls.title: Executive Dinner
calls.summary: The team discussed the upcoming product release 4.4, which will feature AI and enhanced analytics to improve customer engagement and retention. A shift to make Managed Warehouse the default for new signups aims to streamline customer experience and increase upsell potential. Additionally, an executive dinner is scheduled for May 21 at a Michelin one-star venue to foster relationships and explore new business opportunities, specifically targeting key clients and prospects. The guest list will include existing customers and high-potential prospects to maximize value in discussions about AI and experimentation. The meeting emphasized the importance of internal collaboration for outreach and event logistics, alongside clear messaging for invitations to enhance networking opportunities.
calls.keywords: Managed Warehouse, Executive Dinner, Product Analytics, AI / A-B Testing, Customer Engagement, Prospect Invitation
calls.action_items:

Compile and share a detailed prospect invitation list including rationale for each invitee to assist in finalizing the guest list for the executive dinner (15:30)
Manage RSVP tracking for the executive dinner using Excel or a shared document with status tabs to monitor responses effectively (16:10)

**Ashley Stirrup**

**Jake Heier**

**Dan Wathne**
